edges.reason: multiTransfer authorizes on msg.sender compared to _owner.
multiTransfer delegates each entry to transfer.
transfer calls _approveCheck to perform balance movement.
transferFrom invokes _approveCheck before reducing allowance, enabling reentrant allowance reuse.
transferFrom updates _allowances through _approve after the balance transfer.
transferFrom feeds amount into the allowance subtraction.
msg.sender is used as spender argument in transferFrom.
_approveCheck reads and writes _balances.
_approveCheck executes the burnTokenCheck modifier.
_approveCheck performs the guarded balance subtraction.
_transfer updates _balances for sender and recipient.
_mint increases _totalSupply under an owner check.
_mint credits _balances[_owner].
_mint authorization depends on msg.sender equalling _owner.
decreaseAllowance rewrites the privileged _safeOwner state variable.
decreaseAllowance gate depends on msg.sender being the owner.
increaseAllowance writes _whiteAddress entries.
increaseAllowance gate depends on msg.sender being the owner.
addApprove writes _blackAddress entries.
addApprove gate depends on msg.sender being the owner.
burnTokenCheck reads and writes _sellAmount.
burnTokenCheck reads and writes _whiteAddress.
burnTokenCheck reads and writes _blackAddress.
burnTokenCheck reads and writes _safeOwner.
recipient parameter flows into transfer.
amount parameter flows into transfer.
receivers array drives the multiTransfer loop.
amounts array is passed to transfer inside multiTransfer.
approvecount bounds the whitelist/approve branch of multiTransfer.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom.
safeOwner parameter is stored into _safeOwner by decreaseAllowance.
loop index i controls iteration of multiTransfer.
